item.title: How a series of transatlantic letters unlocked a new understanding of economic transformation in Germany

item.title: Men's basketball blunders second half, falls 81-69 to Yale
item.description: After last week's losses to Harvard (13-9, 6-2 Ivy) and Dartmouth (10-11, 4-4), the Bears (7-14, 1-7) entered Friday's matchup in New Haven looking to snap their losing streak against Yale (18-4, 6-2).But in the end, the men's basketball team lost 81-69 to the Bulldogs, who currently hold first place in the Ivy League. item.description: Mukesh Jain, a professor of biology, molecular biology, cell biology and biochemistry, will assume the role of senior associate provost for life sciences, effective immediately, President Christina Paxson P'19 P'MD'20 and Provost Francis Doyle announced in a Today@Brown message on Tuesday.In his new role, Jain will advise both the president and provost on Brown's "life sciences strategy," the announcement read. item.title: Students march, lobby for gun reform following mass shooting
item.description: On Tuesday, around 40 protestors rallied on the Main Green to protest gun violence following the Dec. 13 mass shooting. item.title: Ahmed '27: Study abroad should be taken seriously
